title: Class 10 AI ICT Skills - II
description: Class 10 AI ICT Skills - II , 50 mcq and msq qwestions
subject: ai-artificial-intelligence

questions.question: Which of the following acts as an interface between the user and the computer hardware?
questions.explanation: An Operating System (OS) is system software that manages computer hardware and software resources, acting as a crucial interface between the user and the machine.

questions.question: Which of the following are valid methods to protect your computer against virus infections? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Clicking on links in unsolicited emails

questions.explanation: Antivirus software, scanning external drives, and keeping the OS updated patch vulnerabilities and prevent malicious software from executing. Clicking unknown links increases the risk of infection.

questions.question: A student is working on a shared lab computer. What is the most secure practice before leaving the system?

options.text: Logging out of the user account

questions.explanation: Logging out ensures that your active session is terminated, preventing unauthorized users from accessing your personal files or accounts on a shared computer.

questions.question: Temporary files are created by the system or applications to hold data temporarily. Which of the following statements about temporary files are true? (Select all that apply)

options.text: They can consume significant disk space over time.
They are essential permanent backups of user data.
Deleting them can help improve system performance.

questions.explanation: Temporary files (.tmp) store intermediate data. While useful during active tasks, they accumulate over time and safely deleting them frees up storage and optimizes system speed.

questions.question: Which keyboard shortcut is universally used to rename a selected file or folder in Windows 11?
questions.explanation: Pressing the F2 key allows a user to instantly edit the name of a selected file or folder in the Windows operating system.

questions.question: Which of the following represent examples of computer threats to data privacy and security? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Phishing, Malware, and Spyware are malicious tactics used to steal data or compromise system integrity. Disk Defragmentation is a routine system maintenance utility.

questions.question: When cleaning the computer hardware, which of the following practices should be strictly avoided?

options.text: Using a soft microfiber cloth for the screen
Spraying liquid cleaner directly onto the keyboard
Using compressed air to clean fan vents
Ensuring the computer is unplugged before cleaning

questions.explanation: Liquid should never be sprayed directly onto electronic components like keyboards or screens, as it can seep inside and cause short circuits. Always spray the cloth first.

questions.question: What functions does an Operating System perform? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: An OS is responsible for managing memory allocation, file storage, and peripheral devices. It prevents, rather than creates, viruses through built-in security features.

questions.question: A file with a .docx extension indicates that it is most likely created using which type of application?
questions.explanation: The .docx extension is standard for Microsoft Word and compatible word processing software, signifying a text document.

questions.question: Which of the following actions help in routine computer maintenance? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Clearing the Recycle Bin, running disk cleanup, and removing temporary files keep storage optimized. Disabling a firewall reduces security and is not a maintenance task.

questions.question: In Windows 11, what is the primary purpose of the 'Taskbar'?

options.text: To launch and monitor running applications

questions.explanation: The Taskbar provides quick access to frequently used applications, the Start menu, and displays icons for currently running programs for easy switching.

questions.question: Which of the following constitute proper password hygiene for maintaining data security? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Using a combination of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
Sharing passwords with close friends only
Avoiding the use of personal details like birthdates

questions.explanation: Strong passwords must be complex and unpredictable, changed regularly, and never shared, to prevent unauthorized access and brute-force attacks.

questions.question: What does pressing 'Ctrl + Z' typically do while performing file operations?

options.text: Selects all files in the folder

questions.explanation: Ctrl + Z is a universal shortcut for "Undo," which reverts the most recent action, such as accidentally moving or deleting a file.

questions.question: Which of the following are examples of Operating Systems? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Linux, macOS, and Windows 11 are system software that manage computer hardware. Microsoft Edge is a web browser, which is an application software.

questions.question: You received an email with a lucrative lottery offer and an attachment from an unknown sender. What is the safest course of action?

options.text: Download the attachment to verify the offer
Forward it to your friends to ask their opinion
Delete the email without opening the attachment
Reply to the sender asking for more details

questions.explanation: Unsolicited emails with unexpected attachments from unknown senders are classic phishing or malware delivery mechanisms. Deleting them safely prevents infection.

questions.question: Which mouse actions are commonly used to interact with graphical user interfaces in Windows? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Double-clicking opens items, dragging and dropping moves them, and right-clicking opens context menus. Overclocking is a hardware performance modification, not a mouse action.

questions.question: If your computer system is running slower than usual, what is a primary troubleshooting step related to ICT skills?

options.text: Formatting the entire hard drive immediately
Clearing temporary files and browser cache

questions.explanation: Sluggish performance is often caused by an accumulation of temporary files and cache. Clearing these is a safe, basic first step before attempting drastic measures.

questions.question: What are the key elements of computer security? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: The core principles of information security form the CIA triad: Confidentiality (data is hidden from unauthorized users), Integrity (data is accurate/unaltered), and Availability (data is accessible when needed).

questions.question: What is the correct procedure to properly shut down a Windows 11 computer?

options.text: Pulling the plug directly from the wall socket
Pressing and holding the power button until the screen goes black
Clicking Start, selecting the Power icon, and choosing 'Shut down'
Closing all application windows and unplugging the UPS

questions.explanation: Using the Start menu triggers a graceful shutdown sequence where the OS safely closes background processes and saves system states, preventing data corruption.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about computer viruses are correct? (Select all that apply)

options.text: They can replicate themselves to spread to other files.
They can corrupt or delete data on a computer.
They improve the speed of internet connections.
They are a form of malicious software (malware).

questions.explanation: Viruses are destructive malware designed to replicate, spread, and cause harm, such as data corruption. They never improve system performance.

questions.question: Which keyboard key is typically used to take a snapshot of the entire computer screen?
questions.explanation: The Print Screen key captures the current graphical state of the monitor and saves it to the clipboard, allowing the user to paste it as an image.

questions.question: Why is updating an operating system and antivirus software critical for computer security? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Updates provide patches for newly discovered security vulnerabilities.
Updates permanently stop the computer from aging.
Updates add new virus definitions to detect the latest threats.
Updates often fix software bugs and improve system stability.

questions.explanation: Regular software updates deliver critical security patches, new malware signatures, and bug fixes that protect the system against evolving cyber threats and improve stability.

questions.question: When a user permanently deletes a file using 'Shift + Delete', where does the file go?

options.text: It bypasses the Recycle Bin and is immediately removed from standard access

questions.explanation: Using 'Shift + Delete' permanently erases the file index from the system, bypassing the Recycle Bin, making it unrecoverable through normal user interfaces.

questions.question: Which of the following hardware devices require special care to prevent data loss due to physical damage or magnetic interference? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Storage devices like HDDs, SSDs, and USB drives store critical data and can fail if dropped, exposed to extreme temperatures, or (for HDDs) magnetic fields. Mouse pads do not store data.

questions.question: A user creates a new folder to organize school projects. Which file operation is used to duplicate a file from the 'Downloads' folder into this new folder without removing the original?
questions.explanation: 'Copy and Paste' creates a duplicate of the file in the new location while leaving the original file intact in its source location.

questions.question: Which keyboard shortcut instantly locks your Windows 11 computer screen when you need to step away from your desk?
questions.explanation: Pressing Windows Key + L instantly locks the computer, securing it from unauthorized physical access while keeping your applications running in the background.

questions.question: A student needs to organize a folder containing various media types. Which of the following file extensions specifically identify image files? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: jpg and .png are common image file extensions. .mp3 is an audio format, and .mp4 is a video format.

questions.question: What is the technical term for the initial sequence of events that loads the Operating System into the computer's RAM when it is powered on?
questions.explanation: Booting is the startup process of a computer that tests hardware and loads the Operating System from the hard drive into the main memory (RAM) so the computer can be used.

questions.question: Which of the following are valid reasons for connecting a desktop computer to a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply)? (Select all that apply)

options.text: To prevent sudden shutdown during a power failure
To provide a window of time to save work safely
To increase the processing speed of the CPU
To protect hardware from power surges and voltage fluctuations

questions.explanation: A UPS provides emergency battery backup and surge protection, preventing data loss and hardware damage during power outages. It does not affect processing speed.

questions.question: You want to quickly browse files on your Windows 11 system. Which keyboard shortcut directly opens the File Explorer?
questions.explanation: Windows Key + E is the standard operating system shortcut to quickly launch File Explorer to access drives, folders, and files.

questions.question: Which of the following actions are considered good physical computer maintenance practices to prevent hardware failure? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Keeping food and liquids away from the keyboard
Blocking the CPU cooling vents to reduce fan noise
Placing the system in a well-ventilated, dust-free area
Using a soft, anti-static cloth to gently wipe the monitor

questions.explanation: Proper airflow and avoiding liquids are crucial for computer health. Blocking vents causes overheating, which can permanently damage internal components.

questions.question: A user wants to move a file from the 'Documents' folder to the 'Desktop' without leaving a copy in the original location. Which sequence of commands should be used?
questions.explanation: 'Cut' (Ctrl + X) removes the file from its original location into the clipboard, and 'Paste' (Ctrl + V) places it in the new location, effectively moving it.

questions.question: Which of the following security measures function as a barrier to monitor and block unauthorized external access to your computer network? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Firewalls act as a gatekeeper. They monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic based on predetermined security rules, blocking unauthorized access.

questions.question: In a graphical user interface, what typically happens when you 'hover' the mouse pointer over a file or application icon for a few seconds without clicking?

options.text: A tooltip or small informational box appears
The file is copied to the clipboard

questions.explanation: Hovering triggers a 'tooltip' that displays helpful metadata, such as the file's size, creation date, or a brief description of the application.

questions.question: A user accidentally deleted an important project file. Assuming they did NOT use Shift + Delete, how can they recover it? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Open the Recycle Bin, right-click the file, and select 'Restore'
Press Ctrl + Z immediately after the accidental deletion

questions.explanation: Normally deleted files are temporarily stored in the Recycle Bin where they can be restored. If caught immediately, the Undo command (Ctrl + Z) will also reverse the deletion.

questions.question: Which type of user account in Windows 11 allows you to make system-wide changes, install new software, and manage other users?
questions.explanation: Administrator accounts have full control over the system, while standard accounts can use the PC but cannot make fundamental changes that affect other users or system security.

questions.question: Which of the following are effective methods to back up critical data to protect against hard drive failure or ransomware? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Copying files to an external hard drive
Uploading files to a cloud storage service like Google Drive
Storing files on a high-capacity USB flash drive kept in a safe place
Creating a shortcut of the file on the Desktop

questions.explanation: True backups require storing copies of data on physically separate or cloud-based storage. A shortcut is merely a visual pointer to the original file, not a secure backup.

questions.question: When typing a document, you notice a mistake immediately to the left of your blinking text cursor. Which key should you press to remove it?
questions.explanation: The Backspace key deletes characters to the left of the cursor, whereas the Delete key removes characters to the right of the cursor.

questions.question: Which of the following actions can be performed using the Windows 11 File Explorer? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Searching for specific files using keywords
Viewing the size and modification date of a file
Formatting text into bold and italics

questions.explanation: File Explorer is a file management utility used for organizing, searching, and viewing file properties. Text formatting is done within a specific application like a Word Processor.

questions.question: You need to select 50 files in a folder simultaneously to delete them. What is the most efficient keyboard shortcut to select all items at once?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + A is the universal Windows shortcut to "Select All" items within the current active folder window or text box.

questions.question: A malicious program disguised as a legitimate software or harmless file to trick users into downloading and executing it is known as what? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: A Trojan (or Trojan Horse) relies on social engineering to look like a helpful program, but once installed, it executes hidden malicious code to compromise the system.

questions.question: Where is the 'Notification Area' (also known as the system tray), which displays the clock, volume, and network status, located in Windows 11?

options.text: At the top-left corner of the screen
On the far-right side of the Taskbar
In the center of the Desktop

questions.explanation: The Notification Area sits on the right end of the taskbar at the bottom of the screen, providing quick access to system status indicators and background apps.

questions.question: Which of the following visually indicate that a website is secure and safer for transmitting sensitive information like passwords? (Select all that apply)

options.text: A padlock icon is visible in the browser's address bar
The website has flashy, pop-up advertisements

questions.explanation: HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) and the padlock icon indicate that data transmitted between your web browser and the website server is encrypted.

questions.question: You are working on multiple applications simultaneously. Which keyboard shortcut allows you to quickly cycle and switch between these open windows?
questions.explanation: Alt + Tab opens a visual task switcher interface on the screen, allowing users to rapidly cycle through and select open application windows.

questions.question: When performing a system scan with Antivirus software, which of the following scan types are typically available to the user? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Antivirus software can quickly scan critical system areas (Quick), thoroughly scan every file on the drive (Full), or scan user-specified folders (Custom). It cannot physically scan hardware.

questions.question: What command can be typed into the Windows 'Run' dialog box (Windows Key + R) to directly open the hidden folder containing user-specific temporary files?
questions.explanation: Typing `%temp%` in the Run dialog executes an environment variable that directly opens the hidden AppData\Local\Temp directory to easily manage and clear temporary files.

questions.question: What are the common characteristics of 'Spam' emails? (Select all that apply)

options.text: They are unsolicited and sent in massive bulk.
They frequently contain deceptive links or phishing attempts.
They often advertise fake products, lotteries, or loans.
They are always digitally signed and verified by the government.

questions.explanation: Spam refers to digital junk mail sent to a mass audience without consent. It is frequently used as a vehicle for phishing, financial scams, and malware distribution.

questions.question: A student is practicing good file organization. What is the standard way to create a new folder on the Windows Desktop using a mouse?

options.text: Left-click on the Desktop -> Properties -> New Folder
Right-click on an empty space on the Desktop -> Select 'New' -> Click 'Folder'

questions.explanation: Right-clicking empty space opens the context menu, and the 'New' submenu provides direct options to create folders, shortcuts, and various blank files.

questions.question: Which of the following acts are practical examples of protecting your computer privacy? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Logging out of email and social media accounts on shared computers
Using a screen privacy filter in public places like cafes
Clearing browser history and cookies after using a cybercafe PC
Writing your login password on a sticky note attached to the monitor

questions.explanation: Logging out, using physical privacy filters (to stop shoulder surfing), and clearing digital trace data protect personal privacy. Writing passwords down completely compromises security.

questions.question: If an application in Windows 11 completely freezes and stops responding to mouse clicks or the 'X' button, what is the safest ICT skill to close it?

options.text: Unplug the computer from the main power source immediately
Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to open Task Manager and select 'End Task'
Press the physical power button once
Delete the application's shortcut from the desktop

questions.explanation: Task Manager allows users to forcefully close unresponsive applications via "End Task" without having to abruptly power down the entire system, which could cause data loss in other apps.
